purpose: Small real public-record demo investigations for red-flag rules that 1MDB facts cannot trigger.
quote_convention: Quotes are verbatim from the PDF text layer (PyMuPDF) with runs of whitespace/line breaks collapsed to single spaces. OCR artifacts are kept as-is and flagged in notes. pdf_page is 1-based PDF page index (not the printed page number).
coverage_gaps: BO-001 ownership loop: no official record with a genuine circular ownership (A->B->...->A) was found in this pass; none of these cases contains one. The Glencore swap in deripaska-en-rusal is cross-holding (Glencore in En+, En+ in Rusal), not a loop.
No passport numbers appear in these official releases (the FR notice gives DOB, POB, citizenship, registration and tax IDs).

cases.title: Viktor Vekselberg - layered Panama/BVI/Bahamas shell companies holding US properties and the yacht Tango; sanctions evasion by Vladimir Voronchenko
cases.jurisdiction: US federal - S.D.N.Y. and D.D.C.; OFAC (U.S. Treasury)

rules_covered.BO-002: Two official 5-layer chains, all 100%: Vekselberg -> Company-2 (BVI) -> Foundation-1 (Panama) -> Company-1 (Panama) -> Medallion, Inc. (Panama) -> Voxi Management Corp. (Bahamas) -> properties; and Vekselberg -> Lamesa Group Incorporated (BVI) -> Lamesa Foundation (Panama) -> Lamesa Group Holding S.A. (Panama) -> Lamesa Holding S.A. (Panama). Company-1/Company-2/Foundation-1 are pseudonymised in the record.
rules_covered.SANCTIONS: Vekselberg is an SDN (designated 2018-04-06, E.O. 13662; re-designated 2022-03-11, E.O. 14024); FR notice gives DOB/POB and Renova Group registration/tax IDs.
rules_covered.BO-032: Shared nominee directors (Alcides Higuera Gonzalez, Fredis Abdiel Gonzalez) across Arinter and Lamesa Transport; shared address 'Commerce House, 1 Bowring Road, Ramsey, Isle of Man' for the 'Tango' entity and the Jersey account.
rules_covered.multi-currency: USD account -> EUR account transfer; 180,000 Euros fees.
rules_covered.date-precision: 'in or about 2008', 'in July 2018', 'between approximately February 2009 and March 2018'.
rules_covered.PEP: Not a PEP on these records: designated for operating in the energy sector, not as a government official (contrast Kerimov in deripaska-en-rusal).
